check.text: RECORD COMPLETE: 64 CHOICES, 11 FIGHTS REPLAYED AND MATCHED

event.name: An Old Soldier
event.text: A grey-haired soldier sharpening a blade by the road. "Still got some fight in me. Or some sense, if you'd rather."

options.label: TAKE HIM IN
options.text: He joins you, knowing two abilities.

options.label: A LESSON
options.text: Three members each learn an ability or train one; he stays by the road.

event.name: A Prisoner Cart
event.text: A cart with a cage on the back, two guards dozing beside it. The prisoner watches you.

options.label: FREE THE PRISONER
options.text: They join you, and the guards wake: a fight.

notes: A Prisoner Cart: free the prisoner.
Bought the First light formation for 100.
Room for one more at camp: 3 seats.
Act 2: The Crypt. The Reaper's Court waits at the end.

event.name: The Abandoned Armoury
event.text: Racks of old weapons behind a door hanging off its hinges. Something breathes further in.

options.label: SEARCH DEEPER
options.text: Three rare pieces, and whatever breathes wakes: a hard fight, with an elite's spoils.
